ErrorMessage.title: 该实体处理失败时的错误信息

MetaEntityWriteResult.title: 实体写入结果

description_en: Deletes metadata entity objects in batches. Supports deleting custom entities and extension table type objects (Database/Table). Does not support deleting columns individually. You can delete associated Column objects by deleting the Table
description_zh: 批量删除元数据实体对象，支持删除创建的纯自定义实体，扩展表类型对象(Database/Table)，不支持单独删除column，可以通过删除Table,删除关联Column对象
name: BatchDeleteMetaEntities

parameters.help_en: The list of entity IDs to delete. A maximum of 10 IDs are supported. All entities in the same batch must be of the same entityType
parameters.help_zh: 待删除实体ID列表，最多10个；同一批次必须为同一种entityType
parameters.name: ids

Results.description_en: The list of entity deletion results, which returns the success status and failure reason for each entity
Results.description_zh: 实体删除结果列表；逐条返回删除是否成功及失败原因
Results.title_en: 实体删除结果列表；逐条返回删除是否成功及失败原因
Results.title_zh: 实体删除结果列表；逐条返回删除是否成功及失败原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. When some entities fail, this field still returns true. Check Results[].Success and Results[].ErrorMessage for individual results
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功；部分实体失败时仍返回true，逐条结果见Results[].Success和Results[].ErrorMessage
Success.title_en: 请求是否成功；部分实体失败时仍返回true，逐条结果见Results[].Success和Results[].ErrorMessage
